title: One strict ScrapeOptions contract: formats[], inline return (the ZDR path) and main-content controls
summary: Define ScrapeOptions once in quarry-core (deny_unknown_fields, validate() with field paths, schemars JSON Schema for OpenAPI and the Model Plane tool schema) with formats[] (markdown, html, rawHtml, links, metadata now; json, screenshot and pdf via F-t2-019 and F-t2-023), inline return up to a size cap with artifact-ref fallback, timeout, maxAge, onlyMainContent, include/exclude selectors, extractor choice (readability, clean_full, raw) with a full-HTML fallback, headers and location. Return effectiveOptions and a scrape_id, add GET /v1/scrape/:id (not for ZDR), and embed the struct in crawl, batch, search hydration and schedules.
whyItMatters: Every agent web_fetch pays two calls today (scrape, then GET artifact), and a ZDR scrape returns no content because outputs exist only as artifact refs that are never written under ZDR (SRC). Inline return is the natural ZDR path. One validated contract is what lets the Model propose options and Quarry reject bad ones with field-level 400s. docs/OSS_PARITY_BACKLOG.md:22 claims format parity is done; the code contradicts it (no formats field on ScrapeRequest).

referenceBestPractice.mechanism: Validate the request against a single options schema; take a per-org concurrency permit with a bounded wait (2/3 of the request timeout); run the pipeline in-process; build the Document with only the requested formats (markdown default, rawHtml only on request) and put scrapeId, status code, final URL and queue time in metadata; cross-field rules (waitFor <= timeout/2, action count and total wait caps, one screenshot format); write a per-job access row {scrapeId, orgId, expiresAt} so GET /scrape/:id can re-serve the result, and write none for ZDR. Caution from the reference: it silently defaults skipTlsVerification to true, so echo effective options and never flip a security default silently. || Merged items add: Request: formats: Array<string | {type, ...opts}>; strings are lifted to {type} and validated against a tagged union so each format has its own option schema (serde #[serde(tag="type")] in Rust). Pipeline: fetch once, then run only requested transformers in a fixed order (clean html -> markdown -> links/images/attributes -> LLM formats -> redaction -> diff). Response: one Document with optional fields per format plus metadata {statusCode, sourceURL, url, contentType, cacheState, cachedAt, proxyUsed, creditsUsed, warnings[]}. Exclusive formats (raw base64) are rejected when combined with others. || Parse with a DOM or streaming rewriter (lol_html, kuchikiki). Remove head/meta/style/script/noscript. If includeTags is given keep only matching subtrees; remove excludeTags. If onlyMainContent, remove a fixed list of about 42 chrome selectors unless the node contains a force-include region. Resolve lazy images (data-src, data-srcset, largest srcset) against the base href. Choice of extractor, falling back to full cleaned HTML when readability yields too little text. Firecrawl's optional LLM clean pass is unsupported under ZDR and not worth copying.

verevon.constraints: Ingestion Plane owns the contract; Model Plane web_tools and the Frontend gateway stay thin clients. ZDR: inline return must write no artifacts and no cache, GET /v1/scrape/:id must not exist for ZDR runs, any URL+options cache must be org-keyed and bypassed under ZDR. Crawl and batch are refused under ZDR and crawl is handed to the Go quarry-orchestrator (routes.rs:626), so embedding options in crawl needs orchestrator work in another service. The Quarry workspace has no schemars or utoipa dependency, so the OpenAPI is hand-maintained today.
verevon.approachAdjustment: Scope the first slice to /v1/scrape only: formats[] with inline markdown/html/links/metadata under a size cap with FormatRef fallback, onlyMainContent plus include/exclude via a clean_html stage ahead of readability, effectiveOptions in the response, and switch model-gateway web_fetch to the inline path. Defer embedding in crawl, batch, search hydration and schedules (Go orchestrator). Adopting schemars is a new dependency decision; extending docs/openapi.yaml by hand is the current practice. A whole-HTML fallback already exists when readability fails, so only a user-selectable raw/clean_full extractor is new. maxAge exists as cache.max_age_s but the read path is keyed by prev_fingerprint, not URL plus options. Keep the lenient unknown-field period since the gateway already sends ignored keys.
verevon.effortNote: M holds for the scrape-only slice. Embedding ScrapeOptions in crawl/batch/schedules (orchestrator handoff) would be L and should be a follow-on.
verevon.verdictReason: Premise is verified (no formats field, no inline return, ZDR scrape yields no text, no scrape id route), but partial pieces exist (cache.max_age_s, whole-HTML fallback, ignored formats key already sent by the gateway) and the embed-everywhere scope should be cut to /v1/scrape for the first deliverable.

reference.corrections: (1) 'Write none for ZDR' is a Verevon design choice, not what the reference does. Firecrawl still writes the job-access row and tags it with zeroDataRetention. It refuses GET /scrape/:id only for teams forced into ZDR. (2) The described transformer order does not match the code. The actual order is html, markdown, LLM clean (onlyCleanContent), redactPII, prompt-injection guard, links, images, branding, metadata, product/menu, LLM json/deterministicJson, summary, query, attributes, agent, removeBase64Images, diff, audio/video, then coerceFieldsToFormats. So redaction runs early, not after the LLM formats, and every transformer runs and checks its own option before the final coercion strips unrequested fields. Requested transformers are not the only ones run. (3) The 'choice of extractor with fallback to full HTML' comes from Apify (DOC), not Firecrawl, and Apify ties the fallback to whether the page is a clear article, not to a text-length threshold. Firecrawl uses fixed selector heuristics. (4) Apify Web Fetch does not have 'the same format list': it has only markdown/html/text/links/raw, with no screenshot, json, attributes or images.
caveats: Firecrawl parts are SRC; the Apify Web Fetch and Website Content Crawler parts are DOC-only
The skipTlsVerification=true default is a real footgun in the reference; do not copy it
onlyCleanContent is an LLM pass that is unsupported under ZDR and looks experimental
Firecrawl's openapi.json lags the code (formats are missing), so cite the code, not the spec
